summary: Iteration 5: Verified NEW contractor Mark Settled path (backend + frontend), worker settle regression, negative-path validations (400/404), optimistic UI refresh, and flex-wrap button layout at 420px. Backend pytest 8/8 passed (contractor ledger before settle → net_paid=1500; POST /api/settlements {contractor_id} → net_paid=0 and total_returned=1500; DELETE /api/settlements/{sid} → net_paid reverts to 1500 and auto-return removed; worker settle still zeroes pending=700; missing ids → 400; nonexistent worker/contractor → 404). Frontend @420x900: worker ledger `settle-<wid>` click optimistically flips PENDING ₹700 → ₹0 within 300ms with `undo-settle-<wid>` appearing; Undo reverts pending back to ₹700. Contractor detail sheet `contractor-settle-btn` renders full-width (378px = container 378px), no horizontal overflow (docW 420 = viewport 420), label 'Mark settled' fully visible with whitespace-normal + leading-tight, click optimistically flips NET PAID ₹1500 → ₹0 within 400ms, backend confirms total_returned=1500 net_paid=0 with linked contractor_return (method='settlement', settlement_id set).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py settle() correctly branches on worker_id/contractor_id, raises 400 when neither, 404 when target missing. Contractor path records both settlement + linked contractor_return with settlement_id — clean design allowing DELETE to reverse via delete_many({settlement_id: sid}).
Ledger.jsx settle() optimistic update also recomputes total_settled and net_advance locally — matches backend compute_worker_ledger formula. loadAll() reconciles afterwards.
ContractorsSection.jsx settleContractor() optimistic update sets net_paid=0 and total_returned+=net_paid — matches backend. Button correctly hidden when user.access.locked.
Undo button only exposes latest settlement (l.settlements[0], sorted desc) — acceptable UX per spec.

rca of the issue: User's re-report was because there was no contractor Mark Settled path — only workers had it. Fix (a) extended POST /api/settlements to branch on contractor_id and record both a settlement and a linked contractor_return so contractor_ledger.net_paid becomes 0; (b) DELETE /api/settlements/{sid} pre-deletes linked contractor_returns via settlement_id so net_paid correctly reverts; (c) new contractor-settle-btn added below PDF/Excel/WA with basis-full w-full for full-row layout; (d) worker settle() now does optimistic setLedgers before loadAll() so UI reflects ₹0 pending within same tick. All three regressions verified fixed at 420px viewport.
